note: One long journey (PLAN-AMBIENT Phase 6, his words of 10-17: "looking for waves, psychodelical vibes"). The whole theme is one trip through the macro filter: it starts a quarter of the way up from the dark end, opens to air over three to five minutes (at most 45 % of the theme), holds at most 45 s (a longer hold starts the descent at the peak, so the top breathes), and closes over three to five more back to where it began by the theme's hand-over floor, held there through any blend the set lays, and on to the dark end only in the theme's last two bars, behind every blend: so a seam never lands in the dark, and the next theme's own start is the same corner; eased in and out in octaves, a knot every six seconds. The low end's parallel saturation comes in with the light and leaves with it. The held layer drifts on one tape: a slow sine of 10-20 cents at 0.03-0.07 Hz and a shallow wobble of 2-4 cents at 0.4-0.9 Hz, every held note of the theme where the tape stands at its onset. The stage's treatments turn at 0.03-0.08 Hz. The keys and the bed are sent into a shared return of two ping-pong tape echoes, a dotted eighth and a dotted quarter, fed back long and darkened each pass. The bed stands 4 dB and the keys 5.5 dB under the room's own levels at the place: the growl room's held strings stood their peaks 9-11 dB over the limiter's ceiling at a trim of nought, and a struck four-note keys chord thrown into the echoes 10 dB. Where the theme's lead is the struck keys, each chord it strikes is voiced as a lead plays one, its top two notes touched as one strike: a four-note seventh struck on a bright lead stood its peaks 5-6 dB into the limiter and its level 2 dB over the bed. Where Spark allows (from 0.3), a soft broken pulse far back in the grooves: a frame drum under a muted hand, or now and then a round woodblock, on a swung, broken figure drawn every four bars, fuller as the filter opens. The birds lean it about the place's own values: Veil the swirl's rate, Tide the echoes' feedback (±0.15 at most) and their sends, Root the depth of the dark end (lower as Root rises), Spark the pulse. Numbers are listening hypotheses; the levels were measured offline and silent on the round's site.

space.name: Two ping-pong tape echoes, fed back long
space.says: A ping-pong tape echo at a dotted eighth, filtered 400 Hz to 2.6 kHz in its feedback with the head wandering, and a slower one at a dotted quarter, darker (450 Hz to 2 kHz) and wandering more: a phrase thrown into both writes a phrase of its own crossing the field. Notes are sent straight into each (`journey.echo`, `journey.dub`); nothing passes dry.
